title: The WIFI4 N300 router (Model: T1 Pro) v1.0.0 by U-speed contains an insecure access control flaw that allows an…
description: The WIFI4 N300 router (Model: T1 Pro) v1.0.0 by U-speed has an insecure access control vulnerability due to an exposed UART debugging interface without authentication or authorization. An attacker with physical access who solders and connects to this interface can gain unauthenticated root shell access to the device.
